message: So, we had a little storm brewing last week, and of course, the family group chat lit up. My daughter sent a meme about ‘building an ark’ while my son was busy sharing weather updates. It got me thinking about how important it is to be prepared for those unexpected moments. Here’s a handy guide about floods that might just come in useful during the next family storm watch. Remember, a little planning can help keep everyone calm and collected! 🌧️
